learningObjective: Understand ONNX shape inference and symbolic dynamic dimensions.

canonicalClaims.claim: ONNX shapes can carry symbolic (named) dynamic dimensions; `onnx.shape_inference` propagates shape/dtype through the graph via per-op rules, leaving unresolved dimensions symbolic.
nonImplications: Does not imply shape inference resolves every case.
Does not imply symbolic dims are handled identically by all downstream tools.

misconceptions.claim: ONNX has no shape inference; runtimes must build their own.
Dynamic shapes are represented by a hidden runtime shape-input tensor.
ONNX shape inference is monotonic: adding a pass never reduces information.
misconceptions.whyWrong: Shape inference is designed to be additive but a broken model or bad tool can introduce inconsistencies.
